source_provenance.scope: HistoricalDrosophila annotation records for benign archived computational statistics only;no experimental action or sequence design.

format_transformation: Exact FlyBase FB gene-namespace GAF records for the six declared cellular-component terms; protein/complex identifier namespaces are excluded rather than silently mapped; all qualifying source lines retained, including negated and nonexperimental evidence. is_negated is only the standard parsed NOT qualifier. No ancestry propagation, evidence filter, gene selection or statistical result was precomputed.
